findings.text: Bound conditional valuation and exact-replay evidence exist; they do not establish normalized earnings, model validity, distributable cash, G3 or current price admission.
The 7,464,347,335 denominator and six reviewed report facts are real partial progress; FCFF inputs and complete admission remain absent.

The brief packet has company blockers=[] and observation-plan blockers=[PRICE_NOT_ADMITTED], whereas detailed decisions show multiple blocked research gates. A price refresh cannot make these companies research-ready.

code.mechanism: Fallback observation merges existing blocker lists and price status but does not enumerate absent research assessments; defaults to WATCH.

findings.text: Live API correctly rejects Oct14 as current after Oct15 session completion. Retained packet and model review retain Oct14 historical context; this is not a new valuation or approval and is not treated as an unexpected regression.

No inspected company has an eligible current action plan or approved price policy. WATCH and conditional values are not action thresholds; portfolio eligibility remains unknown without private assessment.

The review API uses generic 409 REVIEW_UNAVAILABLE for both absent manifest entries and changed sources. In this audit these symbols are absent from the explicit manifest; do not report the 409 alone as evidence corruption.

limits: A bounded audit of explicit current bindings and public read surfaces, not a repository-wide proof of historical artifact absence.
Existing receipts and arithmetic were inspected, not regenerated; no new financial conclusions or valuations.
Direct top-level hashes were checked as listed; no claim of independently reauditing every underlying filing or every transitive PIT fact.
No private store or authenticated private endpoint was accessed; public NOT_CONNECTED/unknown projections do not establish the actual private account state.
